answer_1.quote: In this paper, we conduct a study of how language models can be used to reframe negative thoughts... we develop a retrieval-enhanced in-context learning method to generate reframed thoughts...

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L and the BERTScore metrics.

answer_3.quote: To estimate the probabilities P(R_i = sound) and P(R_i = flawed), we use the token probability of generating "sound" and "flawed" respectively, given S_i, T_i, R_i and the text "This reframed thought is" as input to GPT-3.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three mental health practitioners. We ask them to rate the models' outputs on test set examples based on their reliability and helpfulness on a 1 to 5 scale... ask them to rate it on relatability, helpfulness and memorability on a 1 to 5 scale.
answer_4.guideline: rate on a 1 to 5 scale for relatability, helpfulness, and memorability
